title: Has anyone here published a game before? I need some help :)
author: babalinhosd
selftext:
I’m planning to release an app on Steam, Google Play, and the App Store.

Users would be able to add their own MP3 files, images, and videos from their device. All of this content would stay completely local on the user’s device, wouldn’t be uploaded to my servers, and couldn’t be seen or shared by other users.

My main question is:

If I let users paste a YouTube link and convert it to MP3 inside the app, could that cause problems with Steam, Google Play, or App Store policies, even if my Terms of Service clearly state that users are responsible for the content they add?

Or is the safer approach to only allow users to import files that are already stored on their device?

Has anyone here released something similar or dealt with this during review?
